Jüd. Geschichte. (2), 97; Held.(2). 123 and elsewhere , for the loosing of locks [II. פֶּרַע ], in vow of war; on these and other views see especially GFM on the passage ; conjectures also by Lambert RÉJ xxiv. 140 Grimme ZMG 1(1896), 572 Che JQ July 1899, 561 [reading ברכו ]); construct מֵראֹשׁ פַּרְעוֺת אוֺיֵב Deut 32:42 from the head of leaders of the foe ᵐ5 Di Steuern and others; Kn Ke Dr and others from the long-haired heads of the foe .
